content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00177, SRS_Rte_00245 If no RteEventToTaskMapping is defined for DataReceivedEvent s or Swc- ModeSwitchEvent s which are responsible for activating RunnableEntity s of NvBlockDescriptor s (see [SWS_Rte_08087] and [SWS_Rte_08088]), the accord- ing activities shall be processed in the RTE code issuing the DataReceivedEvent s or SwcModeSwitchEvent s. For explicit communication this shall be done in the re- lated Rte_Write function and for implicit communication in the task bodies where the preemption buffers are handled. For SwcModeSwitchEvent s using asynchronous mode switch procedure, this shall be done in the related Rte_Switch function. Note: For SwcModeSwitchEvent s a direct-call requires an asynchronous mode switch.
